title: Two-dimensional lists
sub: Worksheet for the 360° experience: Two-dimensional lists
objectives: know how to build a two-dimensional list as a list of lists and fill it from input
understand how a row index and a column index together pick out one cell
know how to write nested loops that print a grid and total any row or column of it
